EPFO Launches WhatsApp Channel for PF Updates

The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) has launched an official WhatsApp channel to provide members with updates. This channel aims to offer PF-related information directly to subscribers' phones. The initiative allows members to enroll and receive notifications through the messaging platform. Details on how to join the channel and the types of updates available have been provided.
